source_snapshot.items: Intel GNR Demand Scrub CE injection
source_snapshot.procedure: Apply the source BIOS/DFX/RAS matrix and DDR5 ECS; establish clean target state; halt and inject one CE at0x10000 with immConsume=False; explicitly consume it with mem(0x10000); inspect mc0.ch0 machine-check shadow and retry entry1; go and correlate serial/FTrace.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL generic truncated dmesg/SEL evidence omits the latent-to-demand transition and named registers.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Restores exact deferred injection/read/register/extlog/restoration gates and retains critical approval.

old_problem: The approved Intel harness, address0x10000-to-DIMM and mc0.ch0/retry[1] mapping, proof that immConsume=False remains latent, expected correctable register/extlog values, and safe halt/read/go recovery are project-specific and absent.
disposition_reason: ED-16 requires an approved injector, isolated environment and Recovery. This case is not generic CE logging: PASS depends on proving no premature consumption before the explicit demand read and then correlating the intended channel/register/FTrace path. Standard documentation cannot authorize the target address, vendor harness semantics or crash recovery.
decision_basis: Directly read all18 XLSX cells for Reliability row158 and full history2543; preserved unique Source Key and Variant ID.
Preserved DDR5 ECS, exact0x10000 CE with immConsume=False, explicit mem read, mc0.ch0 retry index1, go/serial and extlog criterion.
Distinguished the case from row157 background PatrolConsume and row160 two-event boot-time PPR.
Preserved preexisting logs and required full BIOS/GRUB/DFX restoration; no DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Intel GNR latent CE consumed by one demand read
test_case.purpose: Prove that one CE remains latent until the approved explicit read of the mapped GNR memory target, then follows the intended correctable firmware-first MC/retry/ELog path.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/injector version, hash, license and qualified FAE
Project equivalents and restoration baseline for all BIOS/GRUB/DFX knobs
Expected clean, post-injection latent, post-read MC shadow/retry[1]/extlog fields and timing
Dedicated SUT, stable power, serial/OOB and halt/read/go crash recovery approval
test_case.test_command: After critical authorization, a qualified operator verifies the mapped settings and preserved baselines, clears only approved volatile target state, executes once: halt(); resetInjectorLockCheck(); injectMemError(0x10000, errType="ce", immConsume=False); proves no premature consumption; executes mem(0x10000); captures named MC/retry evidence; executes go(); correlates serial/FTrace/OS/BMC evidence, restores all settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: The mapped target stays unconsumed after injection; the single explicit read produces the approved correctable mc0.ch0 shadow and retry[1] state plus timestamped extlog_mem_event, with no wrong-target/fatal event or crash, and the SUT resumes healthy after complete restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target/harness/settings identity, latent pre-read proof, one demand-consumed CE, exact decoded MC/retry/extlog evidence, healthy resume and complete restoration. Premature consumption, wrong target/severity, missing evidence, hang/crash or restoration failure fails or blocks the engineer verdict.
safety_gate: Dedicated isolated SUT with explicit FAE/injection authorization and independent OOB recovery.
Never infer that0x10000 is safe; approve its DIMM/channel mapping first.
Preserve general logs and clear only approved volatile target registers after baseline.
One injection/read only; stop on anomaly without automatic reinjection or reboot.
expected_evidence: Platform, harness, target and mapped setting identity
Preserved baseline and clean selected MC/retry pre-state
Exact deferred injection transcript and no-consumption proof
Explicit read followed by decoded MC shadow/retry[1] evidence
Final health, full settings restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On premature consumption, wrong target, unexpected severity or hang, preserve evidence and use only approved serial/OOB recovery. Do not reinject or reboot automatically; restore BIOS/GRUB/DFX state under owner control and revalidate platform health.

source_conflict.reason: Deferred CE injection, explicit demand read, register checks and extlog criterion consistently describe one Demand Scrub path.
